summary: Iteration 15 frontend structural changes verified. All SectionDividers removed (0 .sc-dither / 0 .sc-blend in DOM). ValuesSection redesigned: 12 bays, 4 value drives with in-place expand (hovered=866px, others=20px, ratio ~1:43 satisfying >400px vs <40px thresholds), .is-active + parent .is-hovered classes correct, expanded opacity settles to 1 on hover and 0 default, value-name-partnership='Partnerstwa technologiczne'. SwitchSection: 6 ports each with .sc-port__cable containing SVG and .sc-port__label always visible (opacity=1) without hover; labels do not overlap horizontally (20px gap between adjacent boundingRects). New RackServerSection (#lifecycle) with 6 rack units (audit/design/poc/deploy/operate/grow); deploy hover shows 'Wdrożenie' with is-active + chassis is-hovered. New TapeLibrarySection (#tape-library) with 4 cartridges; cartridge-1 (Security) hover reveals 4 items: DLP, IDM, UEM/MDM, Firewall. Section order matches spec: top → values → about → lifecycle → trusted → portfolio → tape-library → sectors → markets-switch → partners-rack → partners → contact. Regression OK: PartnersV2 renders 23 partner links, About has 3 paragraphs, Hero 996px ~ 100vh, 0 console errors, no horizontal overflow on desktop 1920 or mobile 390.
critical_code_review_comments: SwitchSection.jsx still exposes .sc-vinfo info panel below chassis (as expected per spec 'zachowany info panel'). Confirmed rendering correctly with hover — no issue.

ValuesSection expanded opacity transitions smoothly (0→1) confirmed. Default state opacity=0 on non-hovered drives (competence/service/trust). partnership showed 0.098 momentarily after mouse-out during transition wind-down — expected CSS transition behaviour, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 15 acceptance criteria verified programmatically via page.evaluate: (1) 0 dividers, (2) 12 bays / 4 value drives with all data-testids, (3) in-place expand mechanic ratios (866 vs 20 px offsetWidth), (4) 6 lifecycle rack units, (5) 4 tape cartridges with 4 Security items (DLP/IDM/UEM-MDM/Firewall), (6) switch labels always visible with SVG cables and no horizontal overlap, (7) section order in DOM matches spec, (8) mobile 390px no overflow. Screenshots confirm chassis rendering polished. No action items — safe to proceed.
